def run(*args, output=None, accepted=(0,)):
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if output:
        # Diagnostic logs must not corrupt machine-readable JSON reports.
        (OUT / output).write_text(result.stdout if output.endswith('.json') else result.stdout + result.stderr)
    print(result.stdout, end='')
    print(result.stderr, end='', file=sys.stderr)
    if result.returncode not in accepted:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    return result.returncode

def report_xml(path, title):
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    cases = root.findall('.//testcase')
    failures = sum(c.find('failure') is not None or c.find('error') is not None for c in cases)
    skipped = sum(c.find('skipped') is not None for c in cases)
    rows = [f'# {title}', '', f'Executed at {datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}.', '',
            f'{len(cases)-skipped-failures} passed; {failures} failed; {skipped} skipped.', '',
            'Full case identifiers, durations and captured output are in the adjacent JUnit XML.', '',
            '| Test | Result | Seconds |', '|---|---|---:|']
    for c in cases:
        state = 'SKIP' if c.find('skipped') is not None else 'FAIL' if c.find('failure') is not None or c.find('error') is not None else 'PASS'
        rows.append(f"| {c.get('classname')}.{c.get('name')} | {state} | {c.get('time')} |")

def test_sec02_hashes_are_salted_and_passwords_never_stored(app, tmp_path, caplog):
    caplog.set_level('DEBUG')
    a, b = app.test_client(), app.test_client()
    account(a, 'a@example.com', 'A')
    account(b, 'b@example.com', 'B')                      # same password as A
    write(a, '/login', {'email': 'a@example.com', 'password': 'wrong-password'})   # a failed login too
    with app.app_context():
        hashes = [u.password_hash for u in db.session.scalars(db.select(User).order_by(User.id))]
    assert len(hashes) == 2 and hashes[0] != hashes[1]
    assert all(h.startswith(b'$2b$') and len(h) == 60 for h in hashes)     # bcrypt, per-user salt
    assert all(PASSWORD.encode() not in h for h in hashes)
    assert PASSWORD.encode() not in (tmp_path / 'test.db').read_bytes()   # not anywhere in the database file
